sub_strands.name: Commercial Taxes and Data Representation
performance_indicators: Compute personal income tax layouts using standard progressive PAYE tax brackets.
Construct and interpret compound bar graphs and histograms representing demographic data patterns.
Analyze inflation rates and currency index shifts using simple index numbers.

sub_strands.name: Kenyan Constitutional History and Devolution
performance_indicators: Trace the constitutional evolution of Kenya from the colonial era to the 2010 Constitution.
Analyze the structural relationship, power sharing, and challenges between national and county governments.
Evaluate mechanisms of public participation in legislative processes at the county level.

sub_strands.name: Pan-Africanism and Regional Integration
performance_indicators: Examine the origins, key figures, and impacts of the Pan-African movement on continental liberation.
Assess the economic and political achievements of regional blocs including the EAC, ECOWAS, and SADC.

sub_strands.name: Internal Land-Forming Processes and Weather Analysis
performance_indicators: Explain the mechanisms of faulting, folding, and vulcanicity and map their structural distributions globally.
Interpret complex synoptic weather maps using isobar patterns, wind vectors, and satellite imaging data.
Analyze the causes and environmental consequences of global climate change anomalies.

sub_strands.name: Statistical Methods and Fieldwork
performance_indicators: Design a comprehensive geographical fieldwork plan, including data sampling techniques and hypothesis testing.
Process raw field data into statistical charts, maps, and comparative matrices.

sub_strands.name: Sources of Kenyan Law and Human Rights
performance_indicators: Identify and classify the primary sources of Kenyan law, including statutory law, customary law, and equity.
Deconstruct the structure and enforcement mechanisms of international human rights treaties ratified by Kenya.

sub_strands.name: Market Structures and Financial Planning
performance_indicators: Contrast price determination under perfect competition, monopoly, and oligopolistic market structures.
Formulate a complete business plan incorporating marketing strategy, operational design, and cash flow projections.

sub_strands.name: Persuasive Writing and Discourse Analysis
performance_indicators: Draft compelling legal briefs, essays, and editorial commentaries using advanced rhetorical strategies.
Deconstruct ideological biases, tone, and subtextual meanings within political and socio-economic speeches.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Kitaaluma na Ujadilianaji
performance_indicators: Kuandika makala ya kijamii, ripoti za kisheria, na kumbukumbu rasmi kwa kutumia msamiati teule wa kijamii.
Kuhakiki hotuba za viongozi na kubainisha mbinu za ushawishi na matumizi ya tamathali za usemi.
